\section[(dialogue)]{The body, family, verbs and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R74-first-pass-the-body-family-verbs-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a lesson and an answer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an eye, an ear, a nose, a mouth, a tooth
  \item hair, a foot, a finger, a shoulder, the neck
  \item a face, blood, a knee, the back, the heart
  \item a fever, a hospital, ill, pain, medicine
  \item hunger, happy, sad, a doctor, a grandfather
  \item a grandmother, an uncle, an uncle, a husband, a wife
  \item a child, a boy, a man, a woman, a guest
  \item a teacher, to drink, to hear, to sit, to sleep
  \item to stand up, to walk, to run, to play, to buy
  \item to sell, to give, to put, to open, to close
  \item to cook, to wash, to laugh, to cry, to dance
  \item to learn, to forget, to want, to send, to cut
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An eye? (\textbf{\ar{عين}}, \emph{ʿayn}.) An ear? (\textbf{\ar{أذن}}, \emph{udhun}.) A nose? (\textbf{\ar{أنف}}, \emph{anf}.) A mouth? (\textbf{\ar{فم}}, \emph{fam}.) A tooth? (\textbf{\ar{سن}}, \emph{sinn}.) Hair? (\textbf{\ar{شعر}}, \emph{shaʿr}.) A foot? (\textbf{\ar{قدم}}, \emph{qadam}.) A finger? (\textbf{\ar{إصبع}}, \emph{iṣbaʿ}.) A shoulder? (\textbf{\ar{كتف}}, \emph{katif}.) The neck? (\textbf{\ar{رقبة}}, \emph{raqaba}.) A face? (\textbf{\ar{وجه}}, \emph{wajh}.) Blood? (\textbf{\ar{دم}}, \emph{dam}.) A knee? (\textbf{\ar{ركبة}}, \emph{rukba}.) The back? (\textbf{\ar{ظهر}}, \emph{ẓahr}.) The heart? (\textbf{\ar{قلب}}, \emph{qalb}.) A fever? (\textbf{\ar{حمى}}, \emph{ḥummā}.) A hospital? (\textbf{\ar{مستشفى}}, \emph{mustashfā}.) Ill? (\textbf{\ar{مريض}}, \emph{marīḍ}.) Pain? (\textbf{\ar{ألم}}, \emph{alam}.) Medicine? (\textbf{\ar{دواء}}, \emph{dawāʾ}.) Hunger? (\textbf{\ar{جوع}}, \emph{jūʿ}.) Happy? (\textbf{\ar{سعيد}}, \emph{saʿīd}.) Sad? (\textbf{\ar{حزين}}, \emph{ḥazīn}.) A doctor? (\textbf{\ar{طبيب}}, \emph{ṭabīb}.) A grandfather? (\textbf{\ar{جد}}, \emph{jadd}.) A grandmother? (\textbf{\ar{جدة}}, \emph{jadda}.) An uncle? (\textbf{\ar{عم}}, \emph{ʿamm}.) An uncle? (\textbf{\ar{خال}}, \emph{khāl}.) A husband? (\textbf{\ar{زوج}}, \emph{zawj}.) A wife? (\textbf{\ar{زوجة}}, \emph{zawja}.) A child? (\textbf{\ar{طفل}}, \emph{ṭifl}.) A boy? (\textbf{\ar{ولد}}, \emph{walad}.) A man? (\textbf{\ar{رجل}}, \emph{rajul}.) A woman? (\textbf{\ar{امرأة}}, \emph{imraʾa}.) A guest? (\textbf{\ar{ضيف}}, \emph{ḍayf}.) A teacher? (\textbf{\ar{معلم}}, \emph{muʿallim}.) To drink? (\textbf{\ar{شرب}}, \emph{shariba}.) To hear? (\textbf{\ar{سمع}}, \emph{samiʿa}.) To sit? (\textbf{\ar{جلس}}, \emph{jalasa}.) To sleep? (\textbf{\ar{نام}}, \emph{nāma}.) To stand up? (\textbf{\ar{قام}}, \emph{qāma}.) To walk? (\textbf{\ar{مشى}}, \emph{mashā}.) To run? (\textbf{\ar{ركض}}, \emph{rakaḍa}.) To play? (\textbf{\ar{لعب}}, \emph{laʿiba}.) To buy? (\textbf{\ar{اشترى}}, \emph{ishtarā}.) To sell? (\textbf{\ar{باع}}, \emph{bāʿa}.) To give? (\textbf{\ar{أعطى}}, \emph{aʿṭā}.) To put? (\textbf{\ar{وضع}}, \emph{waḍaʿa}.) To open? (\textbf{\ar{فتح}}, \emph{fataḥa}.) To close? (\textbf{\ar{أغلق}}, \emph{aghlaqa}.) To cook? (\textbf{\ar{طبخ}}, \emph{ṭabakha}.) To wash? (\textbf{\ar{غسل}}, \emph{ghasala}.) To laugh? (\textbf{\ar{ضحك}}, \emph{ḍaḥika}.) To cry? (\textbf{\ar{بكى}}, \emph{bakā}.) To dance? (\textbf{\ar{رقص}}, \emph{raqaṣa}.) To learn? (\textbf{\ar{تعلم}}, \emph{taʿallama}.) To forget? (\textbf{\ar{نسي}}, \emph{nasiya}.) To want? (\textbf{\ar{أراد}}, \emph{arāda}.) To send? (\textbf{\ar{أرسل}}, \emph{arsala}.) To cut? (\textbf{\ar{قطع}}, \emph{qaṭaʿa}.)
